51561723.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to His-tagged recombinant human TIM3 expressed in HEK293 cells assessed as dissociation constant by sensor chip immobilization based SPR analysis

original_paragraph.SPR Screening: SPR screening enables label-free hit validation without the need to label TIM-3 with a fluorescent tag, as required for MST. We used Biacore T200 (GE Healthcare Biosciences, Sweden) for SPR screening of the compounds for their TIM-3 binding affinity. We immobilized His-tagged human TIM-3 from SinoBiological (catalog no. 10390-H08H) on series S sensor chip NTA (nitrilotriacetic acid) from Cytiva (Product no. 28994951) using the Cytiva NTA reagent kit (Product #28995043). We diluted stock solutions of the tested compounds in DMSO to maintain the final DMSO concentration at 2% in all tested concentrations. Tested compounds in PBS (pH 7.4) containing 2% DMSO and 0.05% Tween20 were allowed to flow through both ligand-captured flow cells and reference flow cells at the same time (30 μL/min) and contact time (120 s). We included a solvent correction to avoid the effect of DMSO during binding analysis. An extra wash of the flow system using 50% DMSO in PBS was performed after each run. We calculated the K_D values following the 1:1 Langmuir binding model with global fit parameters for solvent-corrected sensograms. The assay was performed in triplicate in three independent runs.
